items.text: Create online store: the sales channel, its keys, a subdomain and the first product feed in one step.
Many shops for one organisation, by location, kind of stock or brand.
What a shop sells is a rule. Stock is shared with the till, so the last unit is never sold twice.
Orders come back as ordinary sales orders, tagged with the shop they came from.
Custom domains: buy one, connect your own, renew it, with certificates handled for you.
Archive a storefront and restore it later.
Shops on their own dedicated hosting.
Sell through social and chat catalogues, or through your own app over the API.
Shopper accounts, and company shoppers who buy for a business.
Delivery zones and rates, collection from a store, and order tracking.
Reviews, wishlists, back-in-stock alerts and prices shown in other currencies.
Subscriptions, bookings, warranties and ordering for a set time.
Online payment from the shop checkout.
Tax on shop orders worked out by the same tax engine as the rest of Clafina.
Account prices, contract catalogues and credit terms.
Purchase order numbers, quotes, returns and coupons.
Theme, pages, menus and collections kept as versions, with preview, approval, publish and roll back.
A visual designer for every page.
A contrast check that keeps text readable on your theme colours.
Publish a change at a time you choose.
Storefront analytics: visits, how many visitors buy, and how quickly pages load.

connectsTitle: Connected to the rest of the business

connects.text: Each shop sells from the places and kinds of stock you choose.
Shop orders arrive as sales orders, ready to fulfil and invoice.
The shop and the till share stock and price books.
Shopper accounts, loyalty points and support tickets belong to the same customer.
The checkout uses the same payments as the rest of Clafina.
Bookings made in the shop use the same booking engine as the rest of Clafina.

faq.q: Do I have to keep a second product list for the shop?
faq.a: No. The shop reads products, stock and prices from the ERP when a shopper visits. Publishing a storefront never changes stock, prices or orders.

faq.q: Can I use my own domain?
faq.a: Yes. Connect a domain you already own or buy one, and renew it from Clafina. Certificates are handled for you.

faq.q: Can business buyers see their own prices?
faq.a: Yes. When a business buyer signs in, they see their account prices and contract catalogue, buy on credit terms and add their purchase order number.
